entities.summary: Cornelis Kiliaan was a Flemish publisher, typographer, lexicographer, linguist, translator and poet. For most of his life, he was in the service of the renowned Antwerp publisher Christophe Plantin. He published the first explanatory dictionary of the Dutch language.
